club.description: Wearmouth Dockers celebrates Sunderland's long association with shipbuilding and riverside industry. The yards along the River Wear, the skills of their workers and the communities that grew around them form the foundations of the club's maritime identity.

descriptions.de: Wearmouth Dockers würdigt Sunderlands lange Tradition im Schiffbau und in der Industrie am Fluss. Die Werften entlang des Wear, das Können ihrer Beschäftigten und die Gemeinschaften, die um sie herum entstanden, bilden die Grundlage der maritimen Identität des Vereins.
descriptions.es: Wearmouth Dockers celebra la larga vinculación de Sunderland con la construcción naval y la industria ribereña. Los astilleros a orillas del río Wear, el oficio de sus trabajadores y las comunidades que crecieron a su alrededor constituyen la base de la identidad marítima del club.
descriptions.fr: Wearmouth Dockers célèbre les liens anciens de Sunderland avec la construction navale et l'industrie des rives. Les chantiers le long de la Wear, le savoir-faire de leurs ouvriers et les communautés qui se sont développées autour d'eux constituent les fondements de l'identité maritime du club.
descriptions.it: Wearmouth Dockers celebra il lungo legame di Sunderland con la cantieristica navale e l'industria lungo il fiume. I cantieri sulle rive del Wear, le competenze dei lavoratori e le comunità cresciute attorno a essi costituiscono le fondamenta dell'identità marittima del club.
descriptions.en: Wearmouth Dockers celebrates Sunderland's long association with shipbuilding and riverside industry. The yards along the River Wear, the skills of their workers and the communities that grew around them form the foundations of the club's maritime identity.
